intro_en: You will learn to talk about buying, fencing and building on a plot of land, and the words for utilities. You will also use -аас хойш (since) in Mongolian and 'was going to... but' and 'would have' in English.
intro_mn: Та газар авах, хашаалах, байшин барих, гэр босгох тухай болон цахилгаан, усны үгсийг сурна. Мөн англи хэлний 'was going to... but', 'would have' бүтцийг хэрэглэж сурна.

vocab.example_en: We got a plot of land near Buyant-Ukhaa.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр энэ газрыг гурван жилийн өмнөөс өмчилж байна.
vocab.example_en: He has owned this land for three years.
We had our fence made of wood.
Where did you put the land certificate?
Electricity has been connected to our yard.

vocab.example_mn: Усны шугам манай гудамжинд хараахан ороогүй.
vocab.example_en: The water pipeline hasn't reached our street yet.
We planned to build a house in the summer.
Let's put up a ger in the yard first.

vocab.example_mn: Газраа хашаалахгүй бол хүн тэнд хог асгана.
vocab.example_en: If we don't fence in the land, people will dump trash there.

sentences.mn: Газраа авснаас хойш бид барилгачинтай уулзаагүй.
sentences.en: Since we got the plot, we haven't met with a builder.
alt_en: We haven't met a builder since we got the plot.
sentences.mn_latin: Gazraa avsnaas khoish bid barilgachintai uulzaagüi.

sentences.mn: Гэрчилгээгээ авснаас хойш тэр газраа хашаалж эхэлсэн.
sentences.en: Since getting the certificate, he has started fencing his land.
alt_en: He started fencing his land after he got the certificate.
sentences.mn_latin: Gerchilgeegee avsnaas khoish ter gazraa khashaalj ekhelsen.

sentences.mn: Бид хашаа барихаар байсан ч мод үнэтэй болсон.
sentences.en: We were going to build a fence, but wood got expensive.
alt_mn: Бид хашаа барих гэж байсан ч мод үнэтэй болсон.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid khashaa barikhaar baisan ch mod ünetei bolson.

sentences.mn: Цахилгаан орсноос хойш амьдрал хялбар болсон.
sentences.en: Life has been easier since the electricity was connected.
alt_en: Since electricity was connected, life has become easier.
sentences.mn_latin: Tsakhilgaan orsnoos khoish amidral khyalbar bolson.

sentences.mn: Хэрвээ шугам ойрхон байсан бол бид худаг ухахгүй байсан.
sentences.en: If the pipeline had been close, we wouldn't have dug a well.
alt_en: If the pipeline had been nearby, we would not have dug a well.
sentences.mn_latin: Khervee shugam oirkhon baisan bol bid khudag ukhakhgüi baisan.

sentences.mn: Газрын гэрчилгээгүй бол банк зээл өгөхгүй.
sentences.en: Without a land certificate, the bank won't give a loan.
alt_en: The bank won't give a loan without a land certificate.
sentences.mn_latin: Gazryn gerchilgeegüi bol bank zeel ögökhgüi.

sentences.mn: Бид байшин барихаар төлөвлөсөн боловч эхлээд гэр босгосон.
sentences.en: We planned to build a house, but we put up a ger first.
alt_en: We were going to build a house, but we put up a ger first.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid baishin barikhaar tölövlösön bolovch ekhleed ger bosgoson.

sentences.mn: Тэр газраа өмчилснөөс хойш нэг жил өнгөрсөн.
sentences.en: A year has passed since he became the owner of his land.
alt_en: It has been a year since he took ownership of his land.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter gazraa ömchilsnöös khoish neg jil öngörsön.

sentences.mn: Илүү эрт хашаалсан бол хөрш манай газраас хэсэг авахгүй байсан.
sentences.en: If we had fenced it earlier, the neighbor wouldn't have taken part of our land.
alt_en: Had we fenced it earlier, the neighbor would not have taken part of our land.
sentences.mn_latin: Ilüü ert khashaalsan bol khörsh manai gazraas kheseg avakhgüi baisan.

sentences.mn: Өвөл болохоос өмнө усны шугамаа татуулах хэрэгтэй.
sentences.en: We need to have the water line laid before winter comes.
alt_en: We need to get the water pipeline installed before winter.
sentences.mn_latin: Övöl bolokhoos ömnö usny shugamaa tatuulakh kheregtei.

sentences.mn: Би гэрээ хотын ойролцоо босгохоор байсан ч газар олдсонгүй.
sentences.en: I was going to put up my ger close to the city, but I couldn't find land.
alt_en: I was going to set up my ger near the city, but no land was available.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi geree khotyn oiroltsoo bosgokhoor baisan ch gazar oldsongüi.

sentences.mn: Манай хашаанд ус, цахилгаан орсноос хойш хөрш нэмэгдсэн.
sentences.en: Since water and electricity came to our yard, we have had more neighbors.
alt_en: Since water and electricity were connected to our yard, we have had more neighbors.
sentences.mn_latin: Manai khashaand us, tsakhilgaan orsnoos khoish khörsh nemegdsen.

grammar.title_mn: Англи хэлний 'was going to... but' ба 'would have'
grammar.explain_en: To say 'since' a finished event, add the past participle -сан/-сэн/-сон/-сөн plus the ablative -аас/-ээс/-оос/-өөс (so -снаас/-снээс/-сноос/-снөөс), then хойш. Choose the vowel by harmony: авсан → авснаас хойш (since getting), орсон → орсноос хойш, хийсэн → хийснээс хойш. The main clause usually describes a state that continues: Газар авснаас хойш бид завгүй байна. (Since we got the plot, we've been busy.)
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд төлөвлөсөн боловч болоогүй зүйлийг 'was/were going to + үйл үг, but...' гэж хэлнэ: We were going to build, but it was too expensive. (Барихаар байсан ч үнэтэй байсан.) Өнгөрсөн нөхцөл байдал өөр байсан бол юу болох байсныг 'If + had + V3, would have + V3' гэж хэлнэ: If we had fenced it, they wouldn't have taken it. (Хашаалсан бол авахгүй байсан.)

examples.mn: Газар авснаас хойш бид завгүй байна.
examples.en: Since we got the plot, we have been busy.
examples.mn_latin: Gazar avsnaas khoish bid zavgüi baina.

examples.mn: Цахилгаан орсноос хойш хүүхдүүд орой хичээлээ хийдэг болсон.
examples.en: Since the electricity came, the kids have started doing their homework in the evening.
examples.mn_latin: Tsakhilgaan orsnoos khoish khüükhdüüd oroi khicheelee khiideg bolson.

examples.mn: Гэрчилгээ гарснаас хойш тэр санаа бага зовдог болсон.
examples.en: Since the certificate was issued, he worries less.
examples.mn_latin: Gerchilgee garsnaas khoish ter sanaa baga zovdog bolson.

examples.mn: Би хашаа барихаар байсан ч мөнгө хүрээгүй.
examples.en: I was going to build a fence, but I ran out of money.
examples.mn_latin: Bi khashaa barikhaar baisan ch möngö khüreegüi.

fill_blank.text: Газраа авс___ хойш бид хашаа барьсангүй.
fill_blank.translation: Since we got the plot, we haven't built a fence.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Авсан' becomes авснаас: the back vowel a takes -аас, so the blank is наас.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Авсан' нь 'авснаас хойш' болно; а эгшигтэй тул -аас нөхцөл залгана.

fill_blank.text: Цахилгаан орс___ хойш бид зуух ашиглахаа больсон.
fill_blank.translation: Since electricity was connected, we stopped using the stove.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Орсон' has the vowel о, so it takes -оос: орсноос хойш.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Орсон' гэсэн үгийн эгшиг о тул 'орсноос' гэж хэлнэ.

fill_blank.text: Тэр газраа ___ хойш хашаа барьж эхэлсэн.
fill_blank.translation: Since he took ownership of the land, he began building a fence.
fill_blank.explain_en: Use the past participle + ablative before хойш: өмчилснөөс хойш.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Хойш'-ийн өмнө өнгөрсөн цагийн -сан дээр гарах тийн ялгал нэмнэ: өмчилснөөс хойш.

fill_blank.text: We ___ going to build a house, but the price of wood went up.
fill_blank.translation: Бид байшин барихаар байсан ч модны үнэ өссөн.

fill_blank.text: If we had fenced the plot, the neighbor ___ have taken it.
fill_blank.translation: Газраа хашаалсан бол хөрш авахгүй байсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: Third conditional: had + past participle, would(n't) have + past participle.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 3-р нөхцөлд 'If had + V3, would have + V3' бүтэц хэрэглэнэ.

fill_blank.text: I was going to ___ a ger in the yard, but it was too windy.
fill_blank.translation: Би хашаандаа гэр босгохоор байсан ч салхи ихтэй байсан.
fill_blank.explain_en: 'Was going to' is followed by the base verb; 'put up' means to erect.
fill_blank.explain_mn: 'Was going to'-ийн дараа үйл үгийн анхны хэлбэр орно; 'put up' нь босгох гэсэн утгатай.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Сайн байна уу, Сара. Газраа авснаас хойш юу хийсэн бэ?
dialogue.en: Hi, Sara. What have you done since you got the plot?
dialogue.mn_latin: Sain baina uu, Sara. Gazraa avsnaas khoish yuu khiisen be?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.mn: Эхлээд гэрчилгээгээ албан ёсоор гаргуулаад, дараа нь хашаа босгосон.
dialogue.en: First I got the certificate officially issued, and then I put up a fence.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ekhleed gerchilgeegee alban yosoor garguulaad, daraa ni khashaa bosgoson.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.en: You were going to build a house, weren't you?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.mn: Тийм, гэхдээ мөнгө хүрээгүй тул одоохондоо гэр босгосон.
dialogue.en: Yes, but I didn't have enough money, so I put up a ger for now.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim, gekhdee möngö khüreegüi tul odookhondoo ger bosgoson.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.en: Have electricity and water been connected?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.mn: Цахилгаан орсон. Усны шугам ойрхон байсан бол бид худаг ухахгүй байсан.
dialogue.en: We have electricity. If the water line had been close, we wouldn't have dug a well.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tsakhilgaan orson. Usny shugam oirkhon baisan bol bid khudag ukhakhgüi baisan.

dialogue.speaker: Бат
dialogue.mn: Ойлголоо. Зун би танд тусалъя уу?
dialogue.en: I see. Shall I help you in the summer?
dialogue.mn_latin: Oilgoloo. Zun bi tand tusalya uu?

dialogue.speaker: Sara
dialogue.en: That would be great, thank you!

culture_note.en: Since the 1990s, many families in Ulaanbaatar have moved to the ger districts, where the state lets citizens own a plot of land. People often fence the plot first, put up a ger, and later build a house, while waiting for water and electricity lines to reach their street. Many residents still haul water from public water points.
culture_note.mn: 1990-ээд оноос хойш Улаанбаатарын олон өрх гэр хороололд суурьшсан бөгөөд иргэд газраа өмчлөх эрхтэй. Ихэнх хүн эхлээд газраа хашаалж, гэр босгоод дараа нь байшин барьдаг, харин цахилгаан, усны шугам гудамжинд нь ороход цаг шаардагддаг. Олон айл одоо ч усны цэгээс ус зөөдөг.

review.notes: Content is good, but there are several grammar errors in the Mongolian 'was going to' forms and in one fill-in-the-blank item that has a doubled vowel.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed word choice, register, tense, case and an ambiguous fill-in option; the grammar sections are intentionally audience-specific and were left as is.

changes.why: 'гэр бариулах' is unnatural; the standard phrase is 'гэр босгох'
'баригч' is not the normal word for builder; use 'барилгачин'
The alternative now duplicates the main sentence
'Нэг жил' is more natural and matches 'a year'
Tense after 'since' and to match 'хийдэг болсон'
Natural word order; 'болсон' shows the change since the event
'put a ger' is also grammatical, so the answer wasn't the only correct option
Register: Бат uses 'та' later, so the greeting must be polite
Wrong case: 'суурьших' takes the dative 'гэр хороололд'
